result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is clipped to 'Tokumaru Ramer' in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' is visually truncated mid-word showing 'Tokumaru Ramer' instead of 'Tokumaru Ramen' despite being fully on-screen. The trailing 'n' is clipped by the rating element on the same row.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title-rating row layout to prevent clipping: allow the title to shrink with proper text-overflow ellipsis or wrap, and ensure sufficient spacing/flex so the full name is readable.
